question: If four resistances of 3 Ω, 4 Ω, 5 Ω and 6 Ω are connected in series, then what will be the combined resistance of the four resistors?
solution:
The correct answer is __**18 Ω**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• When resistors are **connected in series,** their resistances **add up **to give the** total resistance**.
 
• So, for resistors **R₁, R₂, R₃ and R₄​ connected in series**:

Total Resistance,Rₜₒₜₐₗ=R₁+R₂+R₃+R₄

Rtotal=3+4+5+6

**Rtotal=18Ω **
